{"type":"table","name":"epic_metadata","tbl_name":"epic_metadata","sql":"CREATE TABLE epic_metadata (

{"type":"table","name":"evidence_artifact_links","tbl_name":"evidence_artifact_links","sql":"CREATE TABLE evidence_artifact_links (

{"type":"table","name":"evidence_records","tbl_name":"evidence_records","sql":"CREATE TABLE "evidence_records" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  obligation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES envelope_obligations(id),
  evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (evidence_type IN ('receipt','review','human-outcome')),
  receipt_id TEXT REFERENCES execution_receipts(id),
  review_id TEXT REFERENCES review_records(id),
  human_outcome_id TEXT REFERENCES human_outcomes(id),
  producer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (producer IN ('fid','activated-actor','human')),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source IN (
    'fid-executed','activated-actor','activated-human'
  )),
  target_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(target_repository_json)),
  validity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (validity IN ('valid','invalid')),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((evidence_type = 'receipt' AND producer = 'fid'
          AND trust_source = 'fid-executed'
          AND receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'review' AND producer = 'activated-actor'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-actor'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NULL)
      OR (evidence_type = 'human-outcome' AND producer = 'human'
          AND trust_source = 'activated-human'
          AND receipt_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND human_outcome_id IS NOT NULL))
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"execution_attempts","tbl_name":"execution_attempts","sql":"CREATE TABLE execution_attempts (

  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  start_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(start_repository_json)),
  resolved_policy_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  producer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (producer = 'fid'),
  started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (registration_id, registration_version) REFERENCES gate_registrations(id, version)
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"execution_receipts","tbl_name":"execution_receipts","sql":"CREATE TABLE execution_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES execution_attempts(id),
  trust_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_source = 'fid-executed'),
  terminal_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed','timed-out','signaled','spawn-failed','cancelled')),
  exit_code INTEGER,
  signal TEXT,
  timed_out INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (timed_out IN (0, 1)),
  started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  ended_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  terminal_repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(terminal_repository_json)),
  toolchain_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(toolchain_json)),
  output_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_bytes >= 0),
  output_truncated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (output_truncated IN (0, 1)),
  redaction_applied INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (redaction_applied IN (0, 1)),
  rejected_artifacts_json TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (json_valid(rejected_artifacts_json) AND json_type(rejected_artifacts_json) = 'array'),
  CHECK ((terminal_status = 'spawn-failed' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'timed-out' AND timed_out = 1)
      OR (terminal_status = 'signaled' AND exit_code IS NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status IN ('succeeded','failed') AND exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NULL AND timed_out = 0)
      OR (terminal_status = 'cancelled' AND timed_out = 0 AND NOT (exit_code IS NOT NULL AND signal IS NOT NULL)))
)"},
{"type":"table","name":"finding_dispositions","tbl_name":"finding_dispositions","sql":"CREATE TABLE finding_dispositions (

{"type":"trigger","name":"acceptance_criteria_issue_kind_guard_insert","tbl_name":"acceptance_criteria","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER acceptance_criteria_issue_kind_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON acceptance_criteria
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM issues
  WHERE id = NEW.issue_id AND kind IN ('task', 'subtask')
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'acceptance_criteria: issue_id must reference a task or subtask');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"activity_log_ref_integrity_guard_insert","tbl_name":"activity_log","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER activity_log_ref_integrity_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON activity_log
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.ref_type NOT IN ('issue', 'requirement', 'decision')
  OR (NEW.ref_type = 'issue' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.ref_id
  ))
  OR (NEW.ref_type = 'requirement' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM requirement_refs WHERE requirement_id = NEW.ref_id
  ))
  OR (NEW.ref_type = 'decision' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM decision_refs WHERE id = NEW.ref_id
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'activity_log: ref_type/ref_id must resolve to an existing row');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"epic_metadata_issue_kind_guard_insert","tbl_name":"epic_metadata","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER epic_metadata_issue_kind_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON epic_metadata
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM issues
  WHERE id = NEW.issue_id AND kind = 'epic'
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'epic_metadata: issue_id must reference an epic');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_kind_immutable","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_kind_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF kind ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.kind != OLD.kind
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'issues: kind is immutable');
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_parent_kind_guard_insert","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_parent_kind_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN
  (NEW.kind = 'epic' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'task' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic'
  )) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'subtask' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'task'
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, CASE
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'epic' THEN 'issues: epic parent_id must be NULL'
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' THEN 'issues: task parent_id must reference an epic or be NULL'
    ELSE 'issues: subtask parent_id must reference a task'
  END);
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_parent_kind_guard_update","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_parent_kind_guard_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF parent_id ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN
  (NEW.kind = 'epic' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'task' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic'
  )) OR
  (NEW.kind = 'subtask' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'task'
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, CASE
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'epic' THEN 'issues: epic parent_id must be NULL'
    WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' THEN 'issues: task parent_id must reference an epic or be NULL'
    ELSE 'issues: subtask parent_id must reference a task'
  END);
END"},
{"type":"trigger","name":"issues_sequence_scheduling_guard_insert","tbl_name":"issues","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER issues_sequence_scheduling_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON issues FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.kind = 'task' AND (
  (NEW.parent_id IS NULL AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL) OR
  (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = NEW.parent_id AND kind = 'epic') AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id) OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'sequential' AND NEW.sequence IS NULL) OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id AND scheduling = 'prioritised' AND NEW.sequence IS NOT NULL)
  ))
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, CASE
    WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NULL THEN 'issues: unattached task must not have sequence'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epic_metadata WHERE issue_id = NEW.parent_id) THEN 'issues: task parent epic must have epic_metadata'

  FROM issues i
)
